question: Which mountain range is triangular in shape, with its apex at Ratnapuri, the other two sides parallel to Tapti and the holy Narmada river?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Satpura Range**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Satpura Range** is a prominent mountain range in India, known for its **triangular shape**, with its apex at **Ratnapuri**.
 
• The other two sides of the range run parallel to the rivers **Tapti** and **Narmada**, which are important rivers in central India.
 
• The Satpura Range is located in **central India** and spans across the states of **Madhya Pradesh, Maharashtra, and Gujarat**.
 
• It is part of the Vindhyan-Satpura hill system</str
